seo.title: Prime Care | Clinical Diagnostics & Laboratory Equipment in Yemen
seo.description: Certified hematology, blood gas, and HbA1c/ACR analyzers with continuous reagents and Sana'a-based biomedical engineering.

translation.hero_subtitle: Certified hematology, blood gas, and HbA1c systems—backed by steady reagents and biomedical engineers in Sana'a.
translation.pillar_1_desc: Portable blood gas platforms (OPTI, i-SmartCare, i-Check) plus CE & NGSP certified lab analyzers.
translation.pillar_2_desc: Steady local supply of cartridges and B&E reagents compatible with Sysmex, Mindray, and Abbott.
translation.pillar_3_desc: On-site installation, HL7/LIS integration, QC calibration, and preventive service for your team.

translation.testim_subtitle: Direct feedback from healthcare leaders across Yemen.
translation.testim_1_text: Prime Care has proven its immense capability in equipping our laboratories with the latest technologies and best medical devices. We always trust their products, expertise, and rapid response in engineering support and periodic maintenance.
translation.testim_2_text: We are proud of our continuous partnership with Prime Care. They present complete commitment to the highest quality standards in supplying medical and diagnostic consumables, positively impacting the services we provide to our patients.
translation.testim_3_text: One of the best local companies we've worked with in hospital equipment. They stand out with high professionalism and provide immediate, reliable technical support continuously.
translation.testim_4_text: Our partnership with Prime Care has been a quantum leap in our hospital's medical equipment. Punctuality, device quality, and an integrated engineering team working with professionalism and dedication.
